business_problem: Steuerrecht.com is a boutique law and tax advisory firm that aims to compete at the same level as much larger practices. Founder Sebastian Korts and his ten-person team handle complex tax cases, financial analyses, and litigation, often against institutions with far greater resources.
solution_summary: Steuerrecht.com is a boutique law and tax advisory firm that aims to compete at the same level as much larger practices. Founder Sebastian Korts and his ten-person team handle complex tax cases, financial analyses, and litigation, often against institutions with far greater resources. Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to speed legal research and deliver faster, client-ready tax law analysis with consistent quality. Marketing: With ChatGPT, Korts says, "We set up a dedicated blog on tax criminal law, updated weekly. It’s now so comprehensive that we don’t miss a single court decision we’d otherwise have to research manually." They also leverage AI for social media: "Through LinkedIn we’ve positioned ourselves prominently, even transforming photos into animations that draw attention."

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Business
solution_components.role: Provides business users with a secure conversational workspace for drafting, planning, and analysis.

solution_components.role: Package prompts, instructions, and curated context for repeatable internal tasks.
